title: A dead run's dispatched tick still grows a live per-tick elapsed
description:
4dn is open and untouched by this tick: the status model treats the newest run's dispatched/reported row as a live attempt without checking whether that run itself ended, so a failed run's stale dispatched row keeps a growing per-tick elapsed while the run-level clock is frozen. The redesigned frame renders the model's field as-is, so the defect now shows as a wrong elapsed on a HELD-group row.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/build.go isLiveAttempt (per 4dn's record); renderer renders tick.duration_seconds unmodified
